```{r}
library(shinydashboard)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggthemes)
library(forcats)

school_safety <- read_sas("data/pu_ssocs18.sas7bdat")

```

```{r}
#| label: filter-data

# filter the data
school_safety <- school_safety |>
  select(INCID18, # number of total incidents
         INCPOL18,# number of total incident sreported to the police
         C0183, # Social emotional learning
         C0181, # Individual mentoring/tutoring/coaching by adults
         C0179, # Student involvement in restorative circles
         C0186, # Promote sense of community/social integration
         C0204:C0218, # Community Involvement
         C0602, # Threat assessment team formal meetings
         C0669, # Treatment at school by school-employed or contracted mental health professional
         C0266:C0277, # Teacher training
         )
    # this code chunk just might be helpful later on
    #contains("pred"), genre, percentile, runtime, gross)
```
